business_problem: Sandvik Group faces a challenge in unifying their data. Using the Databricks Data + AI Platform, Sandvik has made strides in breaking down data silos, enhancing productivity and accelerating AI-driven innovation.
solution_summary: Sandvik Group faces a challenge in unifying their data. With an ambition to drive AI innovation, Sandvik sought to improve operational efficiency and provide better solutions for their customers in complex sectors like mining and manufacturing. Using the Databricks Data + AI Platform, Sandvik has made strides in breaking down data silos, enhancing productivity and accelerating AI-driven innovation. While scale certainly has its benefits, it also comes with its own set of challenges. As a high-tech engineering company with clients in manufacturing, mining and infrastructure, and 41,000 employees spread across 170 countries, Sandvik knows all about those benefits and challenges. Being a manufacturer with thousands of products being delivered to different customers all over the world, Sandvik has leaned heavily into machine learning to know what product they are going to make, where they are going to make it and to what country the product will be exported.

solution_components.name: Databricks Data + AI Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Unity Catalog
solution_components.role: Applies centralized governance, lineage, and access controls across shared data assets.

solution_components.name: Delta Lake
solution_components.role: Stores curated lakehouse tables used for reliable downstream analytics and AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Lakeflow Jobs
solution_components.role: Schedules and orchestrates recurring data pipelines and production jobs.

solution_components.name: Apache Spark Declarative Pipelines
solution_components.role: Runs declarative batch and streaming transformations with less custom pipeline code.

solution_components.name: Lakeflow
solution_components.role: Coordinates ingestion and transformation workflows across the lakehouse.

data_flow: Source system and event data lands in Databricks, is transformed in Delta Lake tables under Unity Catalog governance, with pipelines coordinated through Databricks orchestration and transformation services.
